alert.encoding: By default, Actovia encodes attachments as base64 inline in the prompt. For large files or vision-heavy workflows, uploading to S3 and passing a URL is more efficient and reliable.
alert.publicReadAccess: Public read access — AWS blocks public access by default. You must disable "Block all public access" on the bucket and attach a bucket policy granting <2>s3:GetObject to <4>*, so the AI provider can fetch the URL without credentials.
alert.cors: CORS — Add a CORS rule allowing <2>PUT from <5>* (or your app origin) so Actovia can upload directly from the desktop.
alert.iamCredentials: IAM credentials — The Access Key ID / Secret Access Key must belong to an IAM user or role with at least <2>s3:PutObject and <5>s3:PutObjectAcl permissions on the configured bucket.
alert.objectAcl: Object ACL — Each uploaded object is set to <3>public-read. Your bucket must not have ACLs disabled (i.e., Object Ownership must be set to <6>ACLs enabled / Bucket owner preferred).
